tasks.subject: Task 1: Move older routes into their own files
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Routes still stored inside older records move to `routes/<id>.json` at launch, and saving a record never drops an embedded route.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Storage/RunStore.swift
- Sources/RunPlan/App/AppModel.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/RunStoreTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Saving a record from `all()` that was stored with its route inside keeps the route
- [ ] `moveEmbeddedRoutes()` writes each embedded route to its own file and rewrites the record without it; records with no route get no route file
- [ ] `AppModel` runs the move at launch, before listing runs
- [ ] TEST passes; BUILD succeeds

**Verify:** TEST with `--filter RunStoreTests` → `Executed 6 tests, with 0 failures`; BUILD → success

```json:metadata
{"files": ["RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Storage/RunStore.swift", "Sources/RunPlan/App/AppModel.swift", "RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/RunStoreTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "TEST with `--filter RunStoreTests` \u2192 `Executed 6 tests, with 0 failures`; BUILD \u2192 success", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Saving a record from `all()` that was stored with its route inside keeps the route", "`moveEmbeddedRoutes()` writes each embedded route to its own file and rewrites the record without it; records with no route get no route file", "`AppModel` runs the move at launch, before listing runs", "TEST passes; BUILD succeeds"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: No auto-pause while GPS settles at the start
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `AutoPauseDetector` pauses nothing until the runner has clearly set off, so standing at the start waiting for GPS is never announced as "Auto-paused".

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/AutoPauseDetector.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/AutoPauseDetectorTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Standing at the start for 30 s with readings wandering 4 m, then running at 4 m/s from 30 s to 60 s and stopping, gives exactly one action: a pause at 66 s
- [ ] The existing timings still hold: pause at 36 s, resume at 64 s when running off, at 68 s or 71 s when walking off
- [ ] The manual-resume test first sets off, so it still checks that a manual resume waits for fresh data
- [ ] TEST passes

**Verify:** TEST with `--filter AutoPauseDetectorTests` → `Executed 7 tests, with 0 failures`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/AutoPauseDetector.swift", "RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/AutoPauseDetectorTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "TEST with `--filter AutoPauseDetectorTests` \u2192 `Executed 7 tests, with 0 failures`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Standing at the start for 30 s with readings wandering 4 m, then running at 4 m/s from 30 s to 60 s and stopping, gives exactly one action: a pause at 66 s", "The existing timings still hold: pause at 36 s, resume at 64 s when running off, at 68 s or 71 s when walking off", "The manual-resume test first sets off, so it still checks that a manual resume waits for fresh data", "TEST passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Keep the checkpoint's route in its own file
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The crash checkpoint writes its route at most every 30 s (and on pauses and skips) into `active-route.json`, while the small checkpoint is still written every 5 s.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Storage/ActiveWorkoutStore.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/DistanceAccumulator.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/OutdoorTracker.swift
- Sources/RunPlan/Workout/WorkoutSessionModel.swift
- Sources/RunPlan/App/AppModel.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/ActiveWorkoutStoreTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Saved with its route, a checkpoint loads back equal, and `active.json` holds no route
- [ ] Saved later without its route, it loads with the newer totals and the route last saved
- [ ] A checkpoint from an older build with the route inside loads unchanged
- [ ] A route file from a workout with a different start time is not attached
- [ ] `delete()` removes both files
- [ ] The session writes the route every 30 s and on forced saves, and nothing in the app names `active.json` any more
- [ ] TEST passes; BUILD succeeds

**Verify:** TEST with `--filter ActiveWorkoutStoreTests` → `Executed 5 tests, with 0 failures`; BUILD → success

```json:metadata
{"files": ["RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Storage/ActiveWorkoutStore.swift", "RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/DistanceAccumulator.swift", "RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/OutdoorTracker.swift", "Sources/RunPlan/Workout/WorkoutSessionModel.swift", "Sources/RunPlan/App/AppModel.swift", "RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/ActiveWorkoutStoreTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "TEST with `--filter ActiveWorkoutStoreTests` \u2192 `Executed 5 tests, with 0 failures`; BUILD \u2192 success", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Saved with its route, a checkpoint loads back equal, and `active.json` holds no route", "Saved later without its route, it loads with the newer totals and the route last saved", "A checkpoint from an older build with the route inside loads unchanged", "A route file from a workout with a different start time is not attached", "`delete()` removes both files", "The session writes the route every 30 s and on forced saves, and nothing in the app names `active.json` any more", "TEST passes; BUILD succeeds"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Break the route's line at pauses
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The route marks the first point after each pause, and the map draws one line per segment, so no straight line crosses ground covered while paused.

**Files:**
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Models/RoutePoint.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/DistanceAccumulator.swift
- RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Models/RouteSegments.swift
- Sources/RunPlan/Workout/RouteMap.swift
- RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/DistanceAccumulatorTests.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Two counted fixes, a paused fix, then two counted fixes give `startsSegment` of `[nil, nil, true, nil]` and segments of 2 and 2 points
- [ ] A route with no marks is one segment; an empty route has none; an unmarked point's JSON has no `startsSegment` key
- [ ] A pause before the first point does not mark it
- [ ] The map draws a line for each segment of two or more points
- [ ] TEST passes; BUILD succeeds

**Verify:** TEST with `--filter DistanceAccumulatorTests` → `Executed 7 tests, with 0 failures`; BUILD → success

```json:metadata
{"files": ["RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Models/RoutePoint.swift", "RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Tracking/DistanceAccumulator.swift", "RunCore/Sources/RunCore/Models/RouteSegments.swift", "Sources/RunPlan/Workout/RouteMap.swift", "RunCore/Tests/RunCoreTests/DistanceAccumulatorTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "TEST with `--filter DistanceAccumulatorTests` \u2192 `Executed 7 tests, with 0 failures`; BUILD \u2192 success", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Two counted fixes, a paused fix, then two counted fixes give `startsSegment` of `[nil, nil, true, nil]` and segments of 2 and 2 points", "A route with no marks is one segment; an empty route has none; an unmarked point's JSON has no `startsSegment` key", "A pause before the first point does not mark it", "The map draws a line for each segment of two or more points", "TEST passes; BUILD succeeds"]}
```
